# Vaidhika Dharma

> Vedic mantras with svara, saṃhitās, nityakarma, and upaniṣads. Devanagari is the default; `/iast/` is Latin transliteration of the same pages.

Site: https://vaidhikadharma.org/
IAST: https://vaidhikadharma.org/iast/
Sitemap: https://vaidhikadharma.org/sitemap-index.xml

## Nityakarma

- Aśvalāyana prātaḥ sandhyā: https://vaidhikadharma.org/aswalayana-sandhyavandanam/prata/
- Āpastamba prātaḥ sandhyā: https://vaidhikadharma.org/apastamba-sandhyavandanam/prata/
- Aśvalāyana brahmayajñam: https://vaidhikadharma.org/aswalayana-brahmayagyam/
- Aśvalāyana samidādhānam: https://vaidhikadharma.org/aswalayana-samidadhanam/

## Veda mantras

- Śrī Rudra Praśnaḥ (Namakam): https://vaidhikadharma.org/sri-rudra-prashnah/
- Chamakam: https://vaidhikadharma.org/chamakam/
- Puruṣa Sūktam: https://vaidhikadharma.org/purusha-suktam/
- Śrī Sūktam: https://vaidhikadharma.org/sri-suktam/
- Nārāyaṇa Sūktam: https://vaidhikadharma.org/narayana-suktam/
- Durgā Sūktam: https://vaidhikadharma.org/durga-suktam/

## Saṃhitās

- Ṛgveda Śākala: https://vaidhikadharma.org/rigveda-samhita/
- Vājasaneyi Kāṇva: https://vaidhikadharma.org/kanva-samhita/
- Vājasaneyi Mādhyandina: https://vaidhikadharma.org/madhyandina-samhita/
- Taittirīya: https://vaidhikadharma.org/taittiriya-samhita/
- Maitrāyaṇī: https://vaidhikadharma.org/maitrayani-samhita/

## Brāhmaṇa and āraṇyaka

- Aitareya Brāhmaṇa: https://vaidhikadharma.org/aitareya-brahmana/
- Taittirīya Brāhmaṇa: https://vaidhikadharma.org/taittiriya-brahmana/
- Aitareya Āraṇyaka: https://vaidhikadharma.org/aitareya-aranyaka/
- Taittirīya Āraṇyaka: https://vaidhikadharma.org/taittiriya-aranyaka/

## Upaniṣads

- Īśāvāsyopaniṣad: https://vaidhikadharma.org/isha-upanishad/
- Kenopaniṣad: https://vaidhikadharma.org/kena-upanishad/
- Kaṭhopaniṣad: https://vaidhikadharma.org/katha-upanishad/
- Praśnopaniṣad: https://vaidhikadharma.org/prashna-upanishad/
- Taittirīyopaniṣad: https://vaidhikadharma.org/taittiriya-upanishad/
- Mahānārāyaṇa Upaniṣad: https://vaidhikadharma.org/mahanarayana-upanishad/
- Aitareyopaniṣad: https://vaidhikadharma.org/aitareya-upanishad/
